verdicts.reason: A splits the circle backdrop from the can: the empty circle sits far left and the tiny can is stranded at the far right. The SOLSTICE wordmark drops below the headline, which breaks the reading order. The CTA is shrunk to a pill the same size as the badges, so it gets lost, and the body copy is crammed into an illegibly tiny block. B keeps the can inside its circle and reads left to right in the original order (brand, headline, body), with a dominant dark CTA at the right end. Its flaws are the circle and can crowding the left edge, the can losing its sun and cap details, and badge text so small it is barely legible.
